description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_downlink_processor_decorator' which decorates a downlink processor with metrics collection capabilities, including an internal resource grid gateway adaptor for timing and metric reporting.

classes.name: phy_metrics_downlink_processor_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for downlink processor that adds metrics collection and timing functionalities.

classes.name: phy_metrics_downlink_processor_decorator::rg_gateway_adaptor
classes.description: An internal class that adapts the resource grid gateway to collect timing metrics and notify the main processor.

methods.name: get_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the downlink_processor_controller interface.

methods.name: configure_resource_grid
methods.description: Configures the resource grid, wraps the underlying processor, and notifies the adaptor.

methods.name: process_pdcch
methods.description: Processes PDCCH PDUs if the underlying processor is valid.

methods.name: process_pdsch
methods.description: Processes PDSCH data if the underlying processor is valid.

methods.name: process_ssb
methods.description: Processes SSB PDUs if the underlying processor is valid.

methods.name: process_nzp_csi_rs
methods.description: Processes NZP CSI-RS configuration if the underlying processor is valid.

methods.name: process_prs
methods.description: Processes PRS configuration if the underlying processor is valid.

methods.name: finish_processing_pdus
methods.description: Notifies the adaptor of PDU processing completion and releases the underlying processor.
